oil.when: 2017–2020 with the steering-wheel arrow and OK buttons
steps: Reset only after the oil and filter have actually been changed.
Turn the ignition on and open the main menu in the instrument cluster with the steering-wheel arrow buttons.
Scroll to Settings and press the right arrow, then scroll to Vehicle and press the right arrow.
Scroll to Oil Life, then press and hold OK while the cluster shows Hold OK to Reset.
Let go when it shows Reset Successful and oil life reads 100%. If it shows Not Reset or Reset Cancelled, go through the steps again.
oil.note: Checked in the 2017 and 2020 owner's manuals.

tpms.when: 2017–2020 (no reset button: the light clears after driving)
steps: Set all four tires to the cold pressure on the driver's door jamb sticker.
Drive above 20 mph for at least two minutes. The light should go out by itself.
If the tires are set correctly, the spare is not on the car, and the light stays on, have the system checked soon.
tpms.note: These manuals give no sensor reset step after a tire rotation, only to check and set the pressures. If the light flashes for about a minute at start-up and then stays on, that is a system fault that adding air will not clear. The light stays on while the spare is fitted. Checked in the 2017 and 2020 owner's manuals.

notes: Fusion uses a calculated oil life reminder, so it will not clear itself after an oil change. The tire pressure light has no reset button on these years.
